judgment_calls.topic: Pointer red box with page logic outside it
judgment_calls.decision: Encoded the sudden vs delayed collapse comparison as two mutually exclusive probable rules (fainting episode / anaphylaxis); the red box is cited by the anaphylaxis diagnosis.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Comment-only .lisp per the pointer-only rule; rejected because the page itself has an 'X likely' and triage logic outside the pointer.

judgment_calls.decision: probable anaphylaxis, so page 28's urgency and management follow.
judgment_calls.alternatives: possible anaphylaxis (would not trigger page 28's urgency).

judgment_calls.decision: Any one of BP < 90/60, pulse > 120, wheeze, stridor, cough, swelling, rash after collapse post-vaccination.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require several features (any2); the page lists them as a picture without a count, and the sudden column excludes all of them.

judgment_calls.decision: Fainting requires SBP >= 90, DBP >= 60 and pulse <= 120 (complement of the delayed column), so the two rules never both fire.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Leave vitals out of the fainting rule (fires more often, can co-fire with anaphylaxis).

judgment_calls.decision: None written; urgency for anaphylaxis comes from page 28, CPR from page 16 / existing warning signs.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A page-15 Urgent rule duplicating page 28.
